title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten current, documented University of Dallas activities and resources that require no admission or purchase.

cards.title: See Mechanical Fortuna
cards.subtitle: Beatrice M. Haggerty Art Gallery
cards.notes: Plan a gallery stop to see the Jason Bly and Suguru Hiraide exhibition before its listed April 24 close; the university states admission is free.
cards.short_summary: A free public exhibition pairing paintings and sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: The Haggerty Art Gallery lists Mechanical Fortuna, on view March 12–April 24, 2026, as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Beatrice M. Haggerty Art Gallery — Mechanical Fortuna
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; exhibition dates are March 12–April 24, 2026.

cards.entity_name: Strength training at the Fitness Center
cards.title: Lift at the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: University of Dallas Fitness Center
cards.notes: Bring your active UD ID and use the free-weight equipment while Fitness Center staff are present; membership is not required for active students.
cards.short_summary: A no-purchase strength workout for active UD students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center has free-weight equipment, and active students receive access automatically without a membership purchase.
cards.access_notes: Active undergraduate and graduate students, faculty, and staff only; present a valid UD ID and use the facility only while staff are present.

cards.title: Do a cardio session
cards.subtitle: University of Dallas Fitness Center
cards.notes: Use the cardio equipment for a self-paced workout during staffed hours; your active student ID grants access without a membership purchase.
cards.short_summary: A campus cardio option included with active student access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center offers cardio and says active student IDs automatically grant access; membership is not required or available for purchase.
cards.access_notes: Active undergraduate and graduate students, faculty, and staff only; present a valid UD ID and use the facility only while staff are present.

cards.title: Go for an indoor run
cards.subtitle: University of Dallas Fitness Center
cards.notes: Use the Fitness Center for a running workout during staffed hours, with access included for active students through their university ID.
cards.short_summary: An indoor running session with no separate membership.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center lists running among its accommodated activities and says active student IDs automatically grant access without membership.
cards.access_notes: Active undergraduate and graduate students, faculty, and staff only; present a valid UD ID and use the facility only while staff are present.

cards.title: Fit in aerobics
cards.subtitle: University of Dallas Fitness Center
cards.notes: Choose an aerobics workout at the campus Fitness Center during staffed hours; active student access is automatic and needs no membership purchase.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost aerobic workout using student facility access.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center lists aerobics among the activities it can accommodate and says active student access requires no membership purchase.
cards.access_notes: Active undergraduate and graduate students, faculty, and staff only; present a valid UD ID and use the facility only while staff are present.

cards.entity_name: Pick-up basketball at the Fitness Center
cards.title: Join pick-up basketball
cards.subtitle: University of Dallas Fitness Center
cards.notes: Coordinate a casual pick-up game through the Fitness Center during staffed access; an active UD student ID provides entry without membership purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fitness Center says it can accommodate pick-up basketball and that active student IDs automatically grant access without membership purchase.
cards.access_notes: Active undergraduate and graduate students, faculty, and staff only; present a valid UD ID and use the facility only while staff are present.

cards.entity_name: Book scanning at Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library
cards.title: Scan and save reading
cards.subtitle: Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the library’s book scanner for notes or excerpts, then save or email the file instead of printing; that scanning service is expressly free.
cards.short_summary: Free digitizing for library materials and documents.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library's guest policy says saving and emailing scanned materials is available free of charge.
cards.source_title: Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library Guest Use Policy
cards.access_notes: Guests may use the library Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; scanner use is limited to 30 minutes daily for public patrons.

cards.title: Read the Dallas Morning News
cards.subtitle: Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library digital resources
cards.notes: Set up or sign into the university-provided Dallas Morning News account with your UD affiliation and use it to catch up on local reporting together.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library states that University of Dallas provides all students, faculty, and staff a free Dallas Morning News membership.
cards.access_notes: Available to UD students, faculty, and staff through the library’s direct-subscription resources.

cards.title: Browse the New York Times
cards.subtitle: Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library digital resources
cards.notes: Register with your UD email through the library instructions, then use the free digital subscription to compare headlines, culture coverage, or puzzles.
cards.short_summary: A free digital newspaper subscription for UD users.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cowan-Blakley Memorial Library instructs users to register for a free New York Times digital subscription using a University of Dallas email address.
cards.access_notes: Register using a UD email address and revisit the New York Times site every six months to renew access.

cards.title: Drop into Open Anselm
cards.subtitle: Anselm Hall, Room 230
cards.notes: Meet other students for the Wednesday evening Campus Ministry gathering in Anselm 230, where the university explicitly provides dinner free to students.
cards.short_summary: A weekly student gathering with free dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Dallas Campus Ministry lists Open Anselm on Wednesdays from 8–10 p.m. in Anselm 230 and states, “Free dinner for our students.”
cards.source_title: University of Dallas Campus Ministry Programs
cards.access_notes: For UD students; listed Wednesdays, 8–10 p.m., in Anselm 230.
